selection: Explicit user decision; not a candidate in a QoS-definition comparison

loss.authentication: blocked: historical stored ratio mixes interval counts and packet rates

throughput_numerics: Require positive offered load; no zero-load imputation. Remove historical 1e-9 denominator epsilon to express the approved positive-load 90% ratio directly. No trained labels are generated until provenance gate passes.
severity_role: Continuous maximum normalized physical-budget exceedance; no compensation; not a finalized reward coefficient
claim_scope: Explicit study-policy budgets, not externally validated 5QI guarantees
training_gate: Authenticate throughput metric/direction and dimensionally valid packet-loss fraction before creating the full four-KPI training targets
